blocks.text: BONK is a symbol; the mint address is the unique on-chain identifier. Two tokens can share similar names — only the mint is authoritative.
Cross-check mints on Solscan or Solana Explorer before swapping. SyNexus accepts symbols for convenience but always resolves to a mint for scanning.
When you scan a token on SyNexus, you can share the URL so friends see the same Sentinel read. That helps groups align on the same contract — not the same ticker on a random chart.
